findings.summary: Dark background with small grey text is hard to read even when enlarged
Large table with many percentage columns; long lines made the reader lose their place
Most tracks show no return, only 'under 3 years'
Nothing says in words which track is the safe one; reader had to guess from '0% stocks'
Track names use English and unfamiliar jargon
Yellow and turquoise pie charts in the exposure column look alike
Site name 'מקור' is unfamiliar; unclear who runs the site
